notes: Actual local execution, not Actions or production acceptance.
First output logger failed after partition 0 had durably completed; its verified result and original reservation were retained, not recomputed.
combinedComputeMs is the sum of the two measured partition durations, not the resumed invocation wall time.
Per-object public files include receipt and manifest; temporary SQLite/work files are excluded.
7600-match scaling is an estimate; all 60 pilot outcomes were win and do not bound long draws.
